create_relatedness_model: create a RelatednessPytorch model for SICK-Relatedness and STS14 semantic similarity tasks
run_semantic_relatedness: run supervised semantic relatedness training with early stopping on Pearson correlation
train_model_epoch: train the model for a specified number of epochs using mini-batch gradient descent
prepare_training_data: prepare numpy arrays as CUDA tensors for training, validation, and test sets
predict_relatedness_scores: predict semantic relatedness probability distributions for input embeddings
